note: Who owns which file in the kit -> template copy. Read by check-kit-sync.mjs. Without this, the checker has only one rule (must match) and reports a template's own test fixtures as drift, which is how a permanently-red gate is built.

kitOwned.means: The kit is the source. The template carries a copy; its CODE must match (prose and formatting may differ - see check-kit-sync.mjs). A template that needs a change here changes the kit and takes the copy. src/** is compared byte for byte (TypeScript and Astro files have no parser here), so the template copies the kit's bytes.

templateOwned.means: The kit ships these as a STARTING POINT, not as a contract: every template tests its own site, so its fixture HTML, its timings and its own constants are meant to differ. Reported for the record, never counted as drift.

optional.means: A template may not carry these at all. base does no source ingestion, so it has no ingest/ and no tests for them. Absent is fine FOR THE TEMPLATES LISTED; present and different is still drift. Scoped per template on purpose: business's compile-seed imports contract/validate.mjs, so 'optional for base' must not read as 'optional for everyone'.

⚠ THE COARSEST ENTRY HERE, AND THE REASON IS A LIMIT OF THE CHECK, NOT A DECISION. This tool's whole run is ONE top-level statement, so declaration-level granularity cannot separate its parts: any edit anywhere inside the loop changes the key. What is genuinely this template's: its own HINT table (product vocabulary; a customer running the kit gets the kit's) and a measureAxis that knows this template's section markup. What was RECONCILED on 19/09 rather than hidden behind this entry: the lazy-image scroll and networkidle pass, which lived only in the kit and base and is now here too. What is STILL open: this copy defaults `rendered` to design.images.sourceSlot + data-filled while the kit defaults to plain `img` — the kit's comment argues this copy's form asks a custom element whether it decoded, which it never did. Changing it alters what this template MEASURES and moves contractHash, so it belongs to the template's owner, not to a sync pass.
